purpose: Record the P22-12 help family physical split completion and the P22-14 doctor family physical split completion.
policy: This evidence does not authorize a broad command package split. Help and doctor are the only moved families; shared helpers, root wiring, JSON helpers, output helpers, help adapter, and bug support bundle code remain in the command package.
preflightContracts: help remains reachable through root help dispatch and command-specific help routing
help output stays stdout-only through the command output adapter
doctor remains reachable through root command dispatch
doctor --json stays stdout-only with stable nextActions fields
bug --json supportBundle remains available for doctor remediation guidance
only help and doctor files moved into dedicated subpackages; shared files remain in the command package

physicalSplitAdmission.nextAllowedAction: Create focused release family preflight evidence after preserving diagnostics, support bundle JSON, stdout/stderr behavior, help routing, and command registration.
physicalSplitAdmission.blockedAction: Do not move shared helpers, root wiring, JSON helpers, output helpers, help adapter, doctor adapter, or bug support bundle code in the next split commit.
physicalSplitAdmission.rollbackRequirement: Restore help or doctor files to cmd/gofly/internal/command in one commit if help output, topic routing, diagnostics, support bundle JSON, command registration, stdout, or stderr behavior changes.
